title: Video Tags Metadata
description: Frame-aligned stages and point-event tags for one video. Frame indices are zero-based; CPU timestamps correlate annotations with the video sidecar and session data.

type.description: Versioned document-type identifier for per-video tags.

video_file.description: Base name of the video file to which these annotations apply.

created_at.description: Local civil time when this tag document was initially constructed.

generated_at.description: Local civil time when the current contents were generated or saved.

session_tags_loaded.description: True after session-level annotations have been imported, preventing accidental duplicate imports.

stages.description: Annotated video intervals. Repeated names represent separate stage occurrences.

name.description: Stage label from the recording configuration or accepted during tag import.

start.description: First annotated frame of the stage interval.

cpu_ts.description: Explicit CPU realtime timestamp selected from the annotated frame's source capture observations, or recorder reception when no source timestamp exists, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

frame_relative.description: Zero-based index within the frames represented by this tag document.

frame_absolute.description: Zero-based index within the specific video file. Currently equal to frame_relative unless session-offset logic is applied.

generated_at.description: Local civil time when this stage boundary annotation was generated.

end.description: Last annotated frame of the stage interval; the boundary is inclusive.

cpu_ts.description: Explicit CPU realtime timestamp selected from the annotated frame's source capture observations, or recorder reception when no source timestamp exists, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

frame_relative.description: Zero-based index within the frames represented by this tag document.

frame_absolute.description: Zero-based index within the specific video file. Currently equal to frame_relative unless session-offset logic is applied.

generated_at.description: Local civil time when this stage boundary annotation was generated.

tags.description: Point-event tags keyed by tag name. Each array contains zero-based video-frame indices in annotation order.

items.description: Zero-based frame index where this point-event tag occurs.
